subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Breaks down and builds up numbers to 8; matches numeral and word cards to 8

show.line: This is seven and this is eight. Seven helping hands. One more makes eight!

rounds.prompt: Count the helping hands. How many?
Five and three more. Which picture shows eight?
rounds.praise: Yes! Five and three make eight.

rounds.prompt: Count the cups Gogo helped wash.
Five, six, seven. What comes next?
Eight can break into two groups. Which picture shows four and four?
rounds.praise: Yes! Four and four make eight.

rounds.prompt: Draw seven with your finger. Go across the top, then slide down.

hints: Seven comes after six. Eight comes after seven.
Count the first group, then keep counting the next group.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Four counters and four more counters.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Four and four. That makes seven!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Four and four make eight.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!

parent_line: Can recognise 7 and 8 and build them from two groups.
